diagnosis: Round 4 performance scan found three actionable issues: (1) Four JS files (bra-calculator-main.js, bra-calculator-enhance.js, bra-calculator-tip.js, bra-calculator-actions.js) all use redundant setTimeout retry loops ([50,250,800] or [0,50,250,800]) — these fire 3-4 extra DOM queries per file on every page load, multiplying to ~12 redundant calls. Since the page already wires everything on DOMContentLoaded with a single retry at 800ms, the intermediate retries are dead weight. (2) The confetti animation keyframe animates translateY from 0 to 360px and rotate 0 to 540deg using transform, which triggers GPU composition on every animation frame — adding will-change: transform to the confetti container pre-warms the compositor layer so the browser doesn't have to promote it mid-animation. (3) The 'Calculating…' spinner button text uses a <span> with class bc-spinner that has no CSS animation in main.css for non-.calc-cta buttons (the spinner animation is only defined for .calc-cta/.btn-primary.is-loading), so the spinner dot never actually rotates on the Calculate button — this is a dead visual that wastes a paint.

patch_list.issue: Triple setTimeout retry [50,250,800] fires 3 extra DOM queries after DOMContentLoaded. Only the 800ms retry is needed as safety net; the 50ms and 250ms retries add no value since the script is already defer-loaded.
patch_list.goal: Reduce redundant DOM queries by 2/3 on calculator page load, saving ~30ms of main-thread work.

patch_list.issue: Triple setTimeout retry [50,250,800] fires 3 extra init() calls. Same pattern as bra-calculator-main.js — only the final 800ms retry adds value.
patch_list.goal: Eliminate 2 unnecessary init() calls that re-query and re-bind form elements on every page load.

patch_list.issue: Triple setTimeout retry [50,250,800] fires 3 extra init() calls. Same dead-retry pattern.
patch_list.goal: Eliminate 2 unnecessary DOM query passes for measure-tip buttons.

patch_list.issue: Quadruple setTimeout retry [0,50,250,800] fires 4 extra renderHistory() calls. renderHistory() queries localStorage and rebuilds the history list DOM — doing this 4 times per page load is wasteful.
patch_list.goal: Reduce renderHistory() calls from 4 to 1, saving 3 localStorage reads and 3 DOM rebuilds per page load.

patch_list.issue: Confetti pieces use transform animations without pre-warming the compositor layer, causing a brief layout thrash on first frame when the celebration fires.
patch_list.goal: Pre-warm GPU compositor for confetti animation, eliminating first-frame layout jank when results appear.
